title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Regarding the issue where the Source Currency Amount in G/L Entry differs from the pre-posting Amount in BC27
summary: When posting general journal lines with foreign currencies in BC27, the Source Currency Amount field in G/L Entry is recalculated from the LCY amount using the exchange rate, resulting in a value that differs from the original journal amount. This occurs because the posting logic recalculates the source currency amount instead of using the amount directly from the journal line.
key_points: Source Currency Code and Source Currency Amount fields were added to G/L Entry table in BC24 with the G/L Revaluation feature
The posting process recalculates Source Currency Amount by dividing the LCY VAT Base Amount by the exchange rate rather than using the journal line amount directly
The recalculation can cause the posted Source Currency Amount to differ from the pre-posting amount due to rounding in the exchange rate calculation
This behavior appears to apply to payment journals with foreign currencies and affects how original transaction amounts are stored

quotes.text: the Source Currency Amount does not match the amount before posting
quotes.why_it_matters: Identifies the core issue: posted amounts differ from what users entered, affecting financial record accuracy

quotes.text: I'm not sure if this is by design or a bug
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights uncertainty about whether this behavior is intentional or an issue, important for understanding whether a fix is needed
